name: @lanework/protocol
description: The HTTP contract between the Lanework desktop app / checkpoint hook and the Lanework API: request and response shapes, types only.
author: fuongz <hi@phuongphung.com>
//: Types and path builders only, no runtime dependencies. It must never import from apps/ or packages/db: it is the half of the contract the open-source desktop ships, and the private API is the other half.
